english.note: Use this when “unfeasibly” stresses that the action or degree is effectively impossible rather than merely impractical.

examples.english: You’re trying to finish an unfeasibly large amount of work in one day.
examples.traditional: 你冇可能噉喺一日內做完咁多嘢。
